_description: Test suites for LLM model category

test_matrices._comment: QB2 (P300X2) bring-up models. Without an entry here run_spec_tests logs 'No spec test suites match' and returns rc=0 with no blocks, so `--workflow release` reports a spec_tests stage that passed without running anything. VLLMParamConformanceTest is model-agnostic (it drives /v1/chat/completions over HTTP and only needs the served model name), so no per-model test code is required. Expect real first-run failures on diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it: its block-diffusion sampler is not an autoregressive decode loop, so n>1, stop sequences, logprobs and seed reproducibility may be genuinely inapplicable rather than broken -- classify those rows against the tt-metal branch behaviour instead of disabling the suite.

The streaming reasoning-boundary regression this suite reproduces lives in the shared qwen3 reasoning parser, which these three specs also select, so it applies beyond Qwen3-32B. Their tool parser differs (qwen3_coder vs the hermes parser the suite was written against), so a failure in the tool-call row needs classifying before it is called a model bug; the reasoning-leak rows are the ones that transfer directly.

test_cases.description: qwen3 reasoning-parser streaming leak / tool-call regressions
